about.title: About me
about.lead: I work with React, Next.js and TypeScript. I care about the code that reaches production being readable and easy to extend six months later: modular architecture, strict types and code review as part of the job, not as an extra.

values.performanceText: I optimize rendering and global state so interfaces load fast and stay responsive on modest devices.
values.architectureText: I separate responsibilities into clear layers so the project stays understandable as it grows.
values.collaborationText: I integrate REST APIs, align endpoint design with the backend team and take part in the team's code reviews.
